# appdynamics_policy (Data Source)

Retrieves the details of a specific AppDynamics policy by ID. Use the appdynamics_policies data source to discover policy_id values.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "appdynamics_policy" "example" {
  application_id = 42
  policy_id      = 937
}

output "policy_actions" {
  value = data.appdynamics_policy.example.actions_json
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `application_id` (Number) ID of the business application this policy belongs to.
- `policy_id` (Number) ID of the policy to retrieve.

### Read-Only

- `actions_json` (String)
- `enabled` (Boolean)
- `events_json` (String)
- `execute_actions_in_batch` (Boolean)
- `name` (String)
- `selected_entities_json` (String)
